name: Nighthawk v2.2.16
body:
### Change log

- NU6 Support

### Installation

- **[App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nighthawk-wallet/id1524708337)**

### IMPORTANT NOTE

Nighthawk is a non-custodial wallet, which means you have sole responsibility over its funds.
Please immediately and securely back up the seed words when you create a wallet.
DO NOT restore non-Nighthawk seed words on the Nighthawk Wallet.
This software is provided 'as is', without warranty of any kind, express or implied.

Nighthawk does not operate the block servers, and the privacy of communication and broadcasting transactions cannot be guaranteed. We recommend using a VPN or Tor for enhanced privacy before making transactions.

Digital wallets can help keep your cryptocurrencies safe, private, and in your control. We highly recommend using wallets to store your digital currency(technically, they store the keys to your addresses). But remember that your wallet is like your bank account, so take extra precautions with your mobile device security, and be sure to perform regular offline backups of your seed words to protect your money.
